links.outcome: Patient information needs and informedness, chatbot plus standard information versus standard information alone
links.effect: Information needs decreased significantly more in the chatbot group than in the control group (p = 0.035). 71.4% agreed the chatbot improved their informedness, and 90.7% would use it again.
links.quote: Our RCT results showed significant benefits of the chatbot in reducing patients' information needs and enhancing their understanding of PC.

screen.reason: This is a randomized controlled trial testing the clinical efficacy of providing an AI chatbot to patients with prostate cancer versus standard care alone, rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
